title: A mechanistic study on the humic substance formation from 5-(hydroxymethyl)-furfural in alkaline solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25132-25140
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02859K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marten Niklas Gey, Uwe Schröder
This study investigates the formation and structural evolution of humic substances from HMF under alkaline conditions, identifying ring-opening polymerization as the key mechanism and highlighting implications for FDCA production.
